Deferred Voxel Shading for Real Time Global Illumination
Computing indirect illumination is a challenging and complex problem for real-time rendering in 3D applications. This global illumination approach computes indirect lighting in real time utilizing a simplified version of the outgoing radiance and the scene stored in voxels.
